name: tilttek/game-engine-bundle
description: Online tables for Symfony on tilttek/game-engine: the games collected from the container, the logs kept by Doctrine DBAL on MySQL, PostgreSQL or SQLite, the states cached in a PSR-6 pool as plain values, a lock per table, every change published on the Mercure topic of its table with identifiers only, the endpoint of a seat's view and of the log of a finished table, commands that create the tables and verify a log, and a Stimulus controller that reads the view again at each update

suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the tables of the logs to the schema the ORM generates, and so to the migrations
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the recipes Card and Badge the template of a table is built of, through the Symfony UX Toolkit
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: For the Stimulus controller that reads the view again at each update
suggest.symfony/cache: To cache the states of the tables in a pool shared by every process
suggest.symfony/console: For the commands that create the tables of the logs and verify a log
suggest.symfony/framework-bundle: For the endpoints of the views and of the logs, and their routes
suggest.symfony/lock: For the lock that keeps two moves at one table apart
suggest.symfony/mercure-bundle: To publish every change of a table on its Mercure topic
suggest.symfony/twig-bundle: For the Twig functions and the template of a table
suggest.symfony/ux-twig-component: For the template of a table, built of the recipes of a kit of the Symfony UX Toolkit
